episode_row: C-03 reconcile applied post-cutoff MLB re-scoring to local files

commits.subject: fix(reconcile): never regrade a date past the BTS 08:00-next-day cutoff (C-03)
commits.body:
The BTS Official Rules freeze a game day's Streak scores at 08:00 ET the next
day; MLB statistic changes after that never count. MLB re-scored two settled
Chandler Simpson singles as fielding errors days later (5/10, 8/20) and the
old 8-day recheck applied both at the day+6 run, overwriting true hits.

reconcile_results now changes a date only while its cutoff is still ahead,
checked at three points: at the start, when that date's feed answer arrives
(the answer may already carry a post-cutoff change -- this also covers a
wall-clock step back), and under scoring_lock right before writing. The
clock is injectable and must be timezone-aware; "today" is the Eastern
calendar day; the season-replay boundary is read fresh under the lock so a
run that waits past midnight keeps the day that just ended. A second cron
run at 07:40 ET narrows the unobserved window before the cutoff.

Best-effort contract (ARCHITECTURE, C-03): "frozen" means no further MLB
regrading, not verified agreement with the contest; a change between the
last run and 08:00 is not picked up. Follow-ups for the 2027 deployment
review: observation receipts, missed-check visibility, contest-ledger
finalization of entered days, and installing the cron line on the box.

Tests: failure-path fixtures for the day+6 overwrite, winter/both-DST/UTC
instants, the UTC-vs-ET calendar day, late answers, lock waits and the
midnight replay; the existing reconcile tests now use fixed dates and an
explicit 02:00 clock. Codex review: r1 BLOCK (2), r2 SIGN, r3 SIGN.
Not deployed: main only; ships with the 2027 season.
